Dan helpt die praktijkkennis enorm om onze klanten en hun vragen snel te begrijpen. Maar heb je geen tandheelkundige achtergrond en herken je jezelf sterk in de rest van het profiel? Dan nodigen we je zeker uit om te solliciteren. Ook ervaring binnen een klantenservice, servicedesk of andere klantgerichte functie is mooi meegenomen. Wat bieden wij jou? title: Graduate Mechanical/Biomedical Engineer (2027 start)
description:
Introduction  

The Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering department is looking for an engineer with strong practical and analytical skills. Working predominantly across healthcare projects, you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle. You will take responsibility for design challenges and technical problems, participating in concept generation, research, design and testing.  

Successful candidates can join us between May - October 2027.  

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

 

What you'll be doing  

You will work within a team of highly talented, supportive and multi-disciplinary engineers on major development projects, applying your practical and analytical abilities to realise novel medical technologies for our clients around the globe. You will participate in projects covering all stages of the development life-cycle, applying novel technologies in the field of medical device development. You will have the opportunity to create exciting cutting-edge technology in areas such as diagnostics, drug delivery, surgical and acute care, synthetic biology and digital health.  

You will be using your strong technical and interpersonal skills to make a significant contribution to development projects, from initial concepts through to final delivery. This will include:  

  • Concept generation  
  • Analysis and development of engineering designs  
  • Rapid Prototyping  
  • Design and implementation of test rigs  
  • Design and execution of experimental test programmes  
  • Presenting results, both internally and to clients  
  • Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation  

 

What you can bring  

We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:

  • An excellent academic record, studying for or having completed a relevant Engineering degree
  • A solid understanding of core engineering fundamentals and physical principles
  • A genuine enthusiasm for tackling real-world problems through engineering
